tagline: Radically shift the global economy toward life-fulfilling entrepreneurial ventures.
hero_kpi_rationale: GoDaddy is actively integrating generative and agentic AI into its products and operations to enhance customer experience and efficiency. AI integration is a key driver for the company's future.

kpis.name: AI-powered experiences
kpis.explanation: Integration of generative and agentic AI into products and operations to improve efficiency and customer experience.
kpis.description: GoDaddy is focused on enhancing its solutions with AI, including tools like Airo, to help entrepreneurs build their identity, presence, and commerce online.
kpis.signal: AI is a major strategic pillar for the company.

kpis.name: Total revenue
kpis.explanation: Total amount of revenue generated by the company.
kpis.description: Consolidated revenue has increased, reflecting growth in both business segments: Applications and Commerce, and Core Platform.
kpis.signal: Strong revenue growth, driven by non-domain products.

kpis.name: International revenue
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue generated outside the domestic market.
kpis.description: International revenues have experienced significant growth, outpacing overall growth, suggesting strong performance in regions outside the United States.
kpis.signal: Strong international revenue growth, indicating successful expansion into foreign markets.

kpis.name: Customer retention rate
kpis.explanation: Percentage of customers retained over a given period.
kpis.description: A customer retention rate of approximately 85% over the past five years (with a slight decline to 84% in 2024 due to rationalizations) demonstrates the strength of customer relationships.
kpis.signal: High and stable customer retention rate, reflecting customer loyalty and service value.

kpis.name: Revenue from prior year customers
kpis.explanation: Portion of revenue generated by customers present in the prior year.
kpis.description: More than 89% of total revenue in 2025 came from customers present in 2024, highlighting strong retention and long-term customer value.
kpis.signal: The vast majority of revenue comes from loyal customers, ensuring a stable and predictable revenue base.

kpis.name: Cohort 2017 retention rate
kpis.explanation: Average annual retention rate for customers acquired in 2017.
kpis.description: The average annual retention rate for the 2017 cohort over seven years exceeds 91%, demonstrating GoDaddy's ability to retain customers over the long term.
kpis.signal: The 2017 customer cohort maintains an exceptionally high retention rate, proving the durable value of GoDaddy customers.

kpis.name: Cost optimization
kpis.explanation: Initiatives aimed at reducing operating expenses.
kpis.description: Cost reduction efforts, including on leases, data center services, and system infrastructure, have been implemented, contributing to improved profitability.
kpis.signal: Cost optimization initiatives have led to improved EBITDA margins.

risks.title: Risks related to AI and new technologies
risks.score_rationale: This risk is mentioned multiple times with strong language intensity, highlighting increased costs, potential litigation, reputational harm, and liabilities. Rapid evolution and regulatory uncertainty justify a high severity rating.

risks.title: Intensifying competition
risks.score_rationale: The text emphasizes the expected intensification of competition and the difficulty in maintaining or improving competitive position. Failure to innovate or meet customer needs amid competition is a major risk.

risks.title: Dependence on customer acquisition and retention
risks.score_rationale: This risk is presented as fundamental to the company's growth. Failure to increase sales to new and existing customers, or a reduction in renewals, would have a material impact.

ai_positioning.summary: GoDaddy is actively integrating generative and agentic AI into its products and operations. AI is a key strategic component of its offering, particularly through GoDaddy Airo, to help entrepreneurs in identity, presence, and commerce. AI is embedded across logo creation, domain search, website building, digital presence development, and business operations enhancement.
evidence: GoDaddy Airo mentioned as an AI-powered tool for domain search, logo generation, website creation, and personalized email
